command:
set -eu
. /etc/os-release
printf '%s:%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
test "$ID" = ubuntu
test "$VERSION_ID" = 16.04
systemctl is-active mysql

set -eu
sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names legacy_shop -e "SELECT TABLE_NAME, ENGINE FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME; SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE, COLUMN_KEY FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION;"

set -eu
for table in customers orders order_items audit_events; do
  printf '%s ' "$table"
  sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names legacy_shop -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $table"
done

set -eu
digest() {
  table="$1"
  sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names legacy_shop -e "SELECT * FROM $table" | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1
}
for table in customers orders order_items audit_events; do
  printf '%s ' "$table"
  digest "$table"
done

set -eu
systemctl is-active mysql
systemctl is-enabled mysql
sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT @@version, @@datadir, @@character_set_server, @@collation_server"
